title: A fine-grained reconstruction of barley’s evolutionary history
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03494-1

Chromosome-scale genome sequences from across the barley genus Hordeum reveal large structural variation, evidence of ancient genetic exchange and extensive divergence of regulatory sequences. These evolutionary processes have generated diversity that could be used to improve cultivated barley.
